entry_state: AppendixA closes with a finite company-to-EPS bridge preserving legal books, dated journals and share histories. AppendixB preserves the historical Core0 grammar and records while directing new exchanges to portable contracts. Its typing, unknown-value, rule-selection and borrowing-request examples retain the body's meanings; the traceability table links requirements to conformance cases. The research/source appendix and bibliography remain.
exit_state: AppendixC identifies the initial research catalogue and later inquiries, technical reading anchors, version/access discrepancies and companion ledgers. It keeps source findings separate from local derivations and retained papers separate from complete technical coverage. The manuscript remains a design with independent implementation, accounting and human acceptance outstanding. The bibliography remains to be read.
findings: The32-paper initial catalogue is explicitly not the full expanded research library, and the original paper collection remains preserved.
The representative technical-support table connects specific sections and equations to bounded design uses; provenance and inverse-problem methods retain their limits.
Working-paper/publication discrepancies, inaccessible candidates and missing correction metadata remain visible rather than being hidden by the bibliography.
The179-candidate initial forward-search population is identified as title/metadata triage, not technical reading or exhaustive coverage.
The final paragraph distinguishes a design specification and author checks from a completed engine or independent acceptance.
